description: As someone who knows litter - both trash and that for cats - MoonForest is by far one of the best brands out there! They sent me 16.5 pounds of litter that will definitely last me a long time, especially since it’s made to be mixed with other brands that aren’t as great! It smells great, covers odors, is completely natural, and clumps without sticking to the bottom of the box. It’s my favorite, I stand by it, and I personally don’t give fake reviews just for the sake of selling things. If I don’t like a product, I don’t want other people wasting their money. I love this product. If you’re a cat owner looking for a new brand or a better brand, I highly recommend MoonForest litter! @MoonForest  #catlitter #litter #litterbox #cat #cats
transcript: One night when I was out cleaning up trash, I found this little baby in a parking lot. So of course I brought her home and I've been raising her ever since, but cats can be expensive. One of the things that you have to continuously purchase when you're a cat owner is litter, but the best litter that I've found is Moonforest. It's virtually dust free, made completely of natural ingredients, and it smells amazing. Moonforest sent me 3 bags of litter, each of them holding 5.5 pounds for a total of 16.5 pounds. And it's made up of only 3 ingredients, tapioca starch, corn starch, and high performance carbon. And the carbon crystals are the little blue bits that you see in the bag. And their job is just to deodorize and neutralize the odors that come from the litter box, including ammonia. Now putting it to the test, this half is Moonforest and this half is a litter that I don't really like. I don't like selling things that I don't personally use, but I've made several videos about Moonforest because it's a product I believe in. And it's such a high quality litter that it is designed to be mixed with others, so here's me doing a little 50-50 mix down the middle. I added the same amount of liquid into each section and waited about 30 seconds since that's how long it takes for my automatic litter box to be triggered. Now doing the scoop test, you can see that the not so great litter definitely sticks and falls apart. The 50-50 mix comes out easier and holds its shape much better. But the Moonforest litter comes right out in a solid block and it's much harder to squeeze and holds its shape entirely. Now doing the crumble test, you can see the block that I already pulled out and all the little bits that stuck to the bottom and were missed. After the bowl was cleaned out, you can definitely tell which side had the Moonforest versus the bad litter and where the 50-50 mix started. And you may be asking what if my cat has the runs and Moonforest has that covered too. I know I'm using chocolate syrup so it's not exactly the same but I can pick it up and squish it without it leaving anything behind on my hands. So when it comes to my automatic litter box, I do a mix of Moonforest litter with the not so great litter since it helps with clumping and not sticking. I'll tag Moonforest as well as the product in this video for any cat owners who want to step up their litter game.
